description.narrative: EBRD invested PLN 120 million (EUR 28 million) in CRR-compliant Additional Tier 1 ("AT1") capital issued by Bank Millennium in bond format. The investment was part of an international PLN-denominated issuance totalling PLN 1.5 billion (EUR 355 million), listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. This was Bank Millennium's inaugural AT1 issuance and the first internationally listed PLN-denominated public AT1 transaction from Poland. The bonds are perpetual, with a call option after 5 years. The project supports the introduction of AT1 instruments to the Polish market through Bank Millennium's inaugural AT1 issuance, which represents only the second public AT1 transaction from Poland. EBRD's participation helps address limited domestic investor capacity and uncertainty over demand for this still-novel instrument, thereby contributing to capital market development. The project also strengthens Bank Millennium's capital resilience and its ability to sustain lending to the real economy by improving the quality of its capital base and supporting capital optimisation.
